# Hungary

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Hungarian Banking Association (Magyar Bankszovetseg)

**Role:** National banking-association XML statement standard workinggroup

**Reporting coverage:** Historical national HU_CAMT053 recommendation presentation

**Messages / versions:** camt.053 (national recommendation selects V02)

- [HU_CAMT053 Hungarian XML statement standard recommendation,25Apr2016](https://www.bankszovetseg.hu/Content/Projektek/HU_CAMT053_pdf.pdf) — specification; public-file

Presentation describes national HU_CAMT053 workinggroup, GIRO documentation/XSD generation, selectsV02 onp10. Intro lists ISOv06 families but that list is not evidence that national HUprofile usesv06. Current definitive implementationguide not verified.

### Hungarian State Treasury (Magyar Allamkincstar)

**Messages / versions:** camt.053 (version not independently verified)
